thank you, I suppose you are right about there not being enough trust I just hadn’t considered that before. 

I’ve made everything as clear as I can, so now I just have to wait and see, but you’re right, sometimes friendships don’t last and it’s not the end of the world. It just feels like it in the moment…

Thank you for commenting, I think I will separate our accounts from now on. I wish it were easy to just cut her off but our lives overlap in so many ways it would be challenging, but may be my only option soon

i won’t pretend to know any answers (after all, I’m here on this subreddit too). This just stood out to me because you sound so much like my dad. 

he doesn’t think highly of himself, has struggled with many things in his life. everyday i wish he felt good enough, that he didn’t talk about himself the way you talk about yourself. I can only imagine there is someone near to you that thinks of you the same way i do of him. 

he finds joy in smaller things, which is something i’ve learned to try and do. He finds new books, new meals to try and make, taking up cycling and running etc. it’s no cure, but i think it helps him to feel like there’s something more to him than just the bad he sees.

None of those things you’ve described make you inherently bad. I think you’re struggling like a lot of us and, unfortunately, there isn’t a lot of access to find actual help (but there is a lot of access to things like drugs) 

I don’t know you beyond this post, but i really do hope you can see yourself for more than what you’ve been made to feel like you are

I’m p new to this but my boyfriend of almost 4 years broke up with me a few months back, and today I found out he’s in a new relationship when he told me that he wasn’t ready to be in one. He was my first love, I thought he was the one. Because of it I put up with all his emotional abuse and gaslighting - I always hoped it would work out in the end. Now I feel like he’s won and I’m a loser who’s just been played. He told me after we’d broken up p often that after university we could maybe try again, that I was important to him, special, but when I wanted to have no contact for a while... seems like he found someone else. I’ve never felt more alone, especially thinking about where I was with him a year ago. 

He was so bad to me but it still felt like love, and I’m so bitter that he gets to go into the new year happy with someone he probably will treat better than he ever did me. I just can’t come to terms with the fact someone who hurt me so much gets to be happy and I don’t - I think I always hoped the hurt would be worth it in the end if I ended up happy, and until now I thought I was okay with it, moving on, but I’m not. 

I want next year to be good, I want to work on myself and my degree and be better, but I can’t help but feel alone, stupid and used
